rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the person or organization meant to receive a letter, message, parcel, or other item.

example.english: The addressee for this parcel is you.
example.traditional: 呢份包裹嘅收件人寫咗你個名。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 baau1 gwo2 ge3 sau1 gin6 jan4 se2 zo2 nei5 go3 meng2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the person or organization to whom a letter is addressed.

example.english: The addressee of this letter is my mother.
example.traditional: 封信嘅收信人係我阿媽。
example.jyutping: fung1 seon3 ge3 sau1 seon3 jan4 hai6 ngo5 aa3 maa1
